Found in Living Memory (`project:game`, 2026-09-26):
- `d887aae3`: Торн/Каэль shared-hunt gate reported `248/3`; intermittent (batches: `1/3` and `6/6` red), unrelated to object files.
- First captured frame at tick `125200` already had both in `dmgBy`: `1002:20 + 1003:13`; all three assertions required a leader-only frame.
- Cause: `mmo/test/e2e.js` staged the joiner inside bite reach at target assignment; both bites could land together. The old TCP-order/stopped-wait fix was already present.
- Fix: commit `6d9a5cb9`, e2e blob `21d21f17`; stage joiner behind leader and evaluate `sharedHuntPhase()` on `why.firstStaged` even without a joint kill.
- Negative control: `mmo/server/player.js` hunting(), `shared = false`, must produce `✗ shared-hunt`.
- Root added `/shared-hunt-e2e-prerequisite`; `object-successors` must inherit the fixed blob and pass e2e before resuming slot07.
- Later prerequisite gate failure was separately in `mmo/test/server/beast-runs.js`; successful final integration was not established by these records.
